content: Pole djone Silase badji o musyengi wu Tesalonike
Banovyoyile o misyengi mi Afipolise na Apoloni, Pole djone Silase bamatole o musyengi Tesalonike, tena ndaghu dusambu dji baSwife.
Mu yuku yandi, Pole amakote o ndaghu dusambu. Kale yilumbu yuvumine, mu tsone yiryeru, amamoghe na amatsunde nowu mu dyambu di Bisonu bi Nzambi.

Adine amabavindiyilaange nobalonzaange nane Bisonu bi Nzambi, bimalasilaange na kengili yiri, Kirisete mbé otsoghusu, akeboku, mbana va djulu vane, mbé orambughe o dufu. Pole akebwébatsingule rye: «Djesu adji menu nyidulonzi, djandi la Kirisete.»
Mwa pesu baSwife bakesinge musamu eni, bamasobene na Pole djone Silase. Vamabe yinombu yineni yi baNgereke bamabande uyitse Nzambi, baghetu bapwele wandi bamabe bidjeti.

Tumbe baSwife bakebase na ngusu. Bakeghukighe yinombu yi makwilisi bamarasunu mu mimbambe, bakesibisi dimbunge mu musyengi. Bakewende o ndaghu dji Sason mu yenerombe Pole na Silase, mubabeghe va wusu mukute.
Basamarasunu Pole na Silase. Ladibandu, bamabeyile Sason na baane ba ngudji bamosi va wusu bivunde bi musyengi. Bakeghamughe, novose rye: «Batu bebabe batsisisene bulongu, bamatole wunu!
Sason amabadile ombu wandi! Batu botsu babe bésalisi na duvyakusunu du mighaghe mi kaghe Sesare, mumbari bévayi yi vadji kaghe mosi, djinengulu Djesu.»
Posulu eni, djikenyoyise mughungi na bivunde bi musyengi.
Sason na batu bandi bakefute yisingu yi dyambu ombu bivunde ne bakebasile.
Pole na Silase béwendi o musyengi Bere
Na mukolu witoli, baane ba tadji bakewendise Pole na Silase o musyengi Bere. Banotole, bakewende o ndaghu dusambu dji baSwife.
Djobane bamabe na mutsanu wuboti tsinane baSwife ba Tesalonike. Bakedile Musamu Nzambi na durondu dwotsu. Kale yilumbu, bamakelulange Bisonu bi Nzambi mu ukelule yiri ame bamabatsingulaange mangenze.
Durangu duneni du batu bakevayile yitu, na va ghari baNgereke: pwele baghetu baghobe na babaale djowandi bakevayile Djesu yitu.
Tumbe ave baSwife ba Tesalonike bamawulu bwé Pole yike mbembu Nzambi elonzi o musyengi Bere wandi, bakesundili urughe mu yisibise dimbunge va ghari mughungi.
Vane-vane, baane ba tadji bakewendise Pole o yari yi mubu. Silase na Timote bakesyale o musyengi Bere.
Pole, amabatsingule djowu abaménebeghaange yi Silase djone Timote batasunu mbangu-mbangu. Bakemutolise o musyengi Atene, mba bakeghabughe o musyengi Bere.
Pole evosili bise musyengi Atene
Temu adji Pole amakelisile Silase na Timote o musyengi Atene, amatsire murime mumbari musyengi wumabe wubase na bakosi.
Amalonzaange baSwife o ndaghu dusambu na botsu abasamabe baSwife, tumbe bamadumaange Nzambi. Kale yilumbu, amayenelonzaange botsu abamenebengunu nandi.
Balonzi ba dyele ba Pikire na ba Senu

bakerughe muyivose nandi. Bamosi bakevose rye: «Yivovi ayiyi! Yi erondi ututsingule vave?» Abane bakewaghule rye: «Etubuli banyambi ba beni!» Djowu bamavosile nane, mumbari Pole amasamune Musamu Wuboti wu Djesu na durambughulu o dufu.
Bakemubeghe nowu, tena va wusu fundu dji banzonzi ba musyengi owu, bamanengilaange «Yiropase». Bakemuwivule: «Turungule udjabe divindughulu di musamu éwuwu wughone witubeyili?
Mumbari yitutsinguli mambu maghone, na twirondi udjabe divindughulu.»
Bise Atene botsu na beni abamatsana o musyengi eni, temu djotsu yisalu yowu bu uvose vo uwulu musamu wughone.
Pole, diteli va ghari fundu dji Yiropase, akebonge mbembu: «Bise Atene, nyimalabe yiri dudji batu, abe bédjabi tinde wuyitse bakosi benu.

Ave nyiyene vyengililaange mu mimbambe myenu, nyiyenelabaange bitumbe bi dighobe abidwiyitsi, na nzirasunu ne yinyenzulu yi paghu na yisonu yéyiyi: “Ombu nyambi adjighédjabunu.” Adji dwiyitsi mba dughedjidjabi, adjine menu nyiruyi oyidulonze.
Nzambi, djandi omavaghe bulongu na byobivu mune, adji Fumu djulu na butambe, djandi aghetsani mu mandaghu amarungu na batu.
Aghésalulu na makake ma batu, mba aghane nzale yisalu wotsu. Mumbari djandi oyiveyi botsu monyu, muvumu na byotsu.
Mu mutu wumosi, amasunde mikute myotsu yiri djowu bakebase butambe bwotsu. Mu bufumu bwandi, Nzambi amasikighe yitsingu yi monyu, na bandilu ma mbure motsanine.
Nzambi amavaghe nane, yiri bakemurombe ne vadji diweru dyumulabe. Yotsu yine, Nzambi aghavale netu,
mumbari batu bévosi rye:
Dyoni dimavosu na bivovi byenu:
Kaboghu tubilange bakule ba Nzambi, toghorungule ubaghusunu Nzambi na bakosi ba lore, ba madilu vo ba mamani, abitulu na matase ma batu.
Nzambi aghékipi temu adji mbé bakamudjabile, tumbe erondi yiri batu botsu, mu mbure tsyotsu, bakesanze mutsanu na umughobise.
Mumbari Nzambi, amasikighe yilumbu ayi mutu awu djabeni amasole, ososisile batu botsu mu butambe mu dusungughu dwandi. Nzambi amalase kengili kake andi, ave amamurambusile o dufu.»
Ave djowu bamawululu dyambu di batu abafu bwé boghabughe monyu, abane bamamupedji. Bamosi bamavose rye: «Djetu tuwuwululu mu dyoni temu susu.»
Na vane, Pole akebasile.

Va djulu vane, mwa dikabu di batu bamasobene nandi na bamakalughe bakereti. Mu yinombu yeni, vamabe dibaale dimosi mu fundu banzonzi bamanengilaange Deni, mughetu dine dyandi Damarise, na bamosi wandi.
